mapper.select: select o.id orderId, o.buyer_brand_id buyerBrandId, b.customer_id buyerUserId, b.brand_name buyerName, b.avator buyerAvatar, o.create_at createAt, o.order_status orderStatus, o.payment_status paymentStatus, o.pay_amount payAmount, o.recipient, o.recipient_phone recipientPhone, o.shipping_address shippingAddress, o.shipping_method shippingMethod, o.shipping_note shippingNote, o.shipping_number shippingNumber, o.shipping_status shippingStatus, o.courier_phone courierPhone, i.id item_orderItemId, i.order_id item_orderId, i.product_id item_productId, i.product_name item_productName, CAST(i.product_price AS CHAR) item_productPrice, i.product_thumbnail item_productThumbnail, CAST(i.quantity AS CHAR) item_quantity, i.refund_reason item_refundReason, CAST(i.split_pay_amount AS CHAR) item_splitPayAmount, CAST(i.split_promotion_amount AS CHAR) item_splitPromotionAmount, i.status item_status from physical_order o inner join brand b on o.buyer_brand_id = b.id inner join physical_order_item i on o.id = i.order_id where o.id = #{orderId} AND o.seller_brand_id = #{brandId} order by i.create_at asc

select id orderId, courier_phone courierPhone, recipient, recipient_phone recipientPhone, shipping_address shippingAddress, shipping_method shippingMethod, shipping_note shippingNote, shipping_number shippingNumber, shipping_status shippingStatus from physical_order where id = #{orderId} AND (seller_brand_id = #{brandId} OR buyer_brand_id = #{brandId})
